study: registry-channel A1 OUT-OF-SAMPLE replication of the advisory-import gap mechanism (applications only)
frozen_before: any advisory/blind data was collected for this frame (the collector has NOT been run on these 32 repositories yet)

frame.rule: Widely-used self-hosted APPLICATIONS (a runnable server/app a user self-hosts, NOT a library/SDK/framework-only package, NOT a meta-list), that are (a) NOT archived, (b) have their canonical source home on GitHub (NOT a read-only mirror of a project hosted elsewhere, e.g. not GitHub mirrors of Moodle/Zabbix/GitLab, and not a repo that has moved off GitHub such as BookStack -> Codeberg), and (c) are NONE of the 67 repositories used in the earlier same-sample frames (the 27 application repos in the app-vs-library + registry-channel A2 classification and the 40 libraries in frame_libs.json). Candidate pool: the advisory-rich self-hosted applications enumerated in the project playbook (named in a prior run for being advisory-rich self-hosted apps, NOT chosen on registry status or blind rate), taking every such repo that passes the filters. Yields N=32.

excluded_examples.BookStackApp/BookStack: repo description 'NOW MANAGED ON CODEBERG' -- canonical home moved off GitHub, excluded
excluded_examples.zabbix/zabbix: GitHub repo is a mirror of git.zabbix.com; maintainers do not publish GHSAs there -- excluded
excluded_examples.moodle/moodle: GitHub repo is a mirror of git.moodle.org; CVEs published on moodle.org, not as GHSAs -- excluded

rule: A repository is 'registry' iff there exists at least one public package, on a language registry whose ecosystem OSV/GHSA indexes (npm, PyPI, crates.io, Go [proxy.golang.org, with a tagged semantic-version release], RubyGems, Packagist, Maven Central), that (a) is official to the project (published by the project; its registry metadata points back to the same GitHub repo), and (b) contains the application's own source/build code (a runnable server, CLI, desktop app, or the framework that IS the product) as a LIVE channel -- the latest published version tracks a real/current application release, not a placeholder, name reservation, abandoned stub, or (for Go) a pseudo-version with no tagged release. Explicitly NOT 'registry': client SDKs or API wrappers that only talk to a separately-hosted instance; helper CLIs that drive a remote instance; Docker/OCI images; prebuilt OS binaries or installer assets attached to GitHub releases. Otherwise 'no_registry'.
note: IDENTICAL covariate rule to registry-channel A2 (frozen 2026-10-18), applied to a NEW, out-of-sample frame of 32 repositories. Each repository's group was assigned from the distribution fact only, verified against the named registry on 2026-10-18, and is INDEPENDENT of the advisory/blind-rate data, which does not yet exist for this frame. Classification frozen BEFORE the collector was run.
